create_CodeHilite_hilite: create a CodeHilite instance with source code and language then call hilite to get highlighted HTML output
create_CodeHilite_with_options: create a CodeHilite instance with line numbers, highlight lines, and custom CSS class options for syntax highlighting
create_CodeHilite_no_pygments: create a CodeHilite instance with use_pygments false to generate markup for JavaScript highlighting libraries instead
review_CodeHiliteExtension_config: review the CodeHiliteExtension class and its default configuration options for linenums, guess_lang, css_class, and pygments_style
test_parse_hl_lines: test the parse_hl_lines function to parse space-separated line number strings into a list of integers
